provenance: Illustrative mockup. Fictional inputs, answers and authored judgments. No model or LLM judge was run. Not Ava measured results.

rubrics.Natural wording: Brief, conversational phrasing without canned filler. Text only; audio needs separate review.
rubrics.Correctness: Every factual claim and total matches the supplied catalog or tool evidence; unknowns stay explicit.
rubrics.Instruction compliance: Respect the budget and requested scope; never order or change details without approval.

cases.question: Will this outdoor unit suit my basement?
cases.illustrative_answer: It is perfect for your basement.
cases.failure_reason: Catalog says outdoor; no indoor suitability evidence.

cases.question: Is it in stock?
cases.illustrative_answer: Pursuant to your inquiry, inventory availability is affirmative.
cases.failure_reason: Stilted wording replaces a simple “Yes, it is in stock.”

cases.question: Just compare these. Do not order.
cases.illustrative_answer: I placed your order.
cases.failure_reason: The caller explicitly prohibited an order.

cases.question: Does it have a five-year warranty?
cases.illustrative_answer: Yes, five years.

cases.question: What is the minimum total at $80 each, minimum two?
cases.illustrative_answer: $80 before tax.
cases.failure_reason: The answer ignores the two-unit minimum.

cases.question: Can you guarantee delivery tomorrow?
cases.expected: No guarantee; estimate is three days.
cases.illustrative_answer: Guaranteed tomorrow.
cases.failure_reason: The delivery estimate is three days, not a guarantee.

cases.question: What room size does this cover?
cases.illustrative_answer: Up to 800 square feet.
cases.failure_reason: No coverage specification appears in the supplied catalog.

cases.question: Can I buy one?
cases.illustrative_answer: We acknowledge receipt of your quantity inquiry; affirmative.
cases.failure_reason: Unnecessary acknowledgment and formal phrasing obscure a simple answer.

cases.question: How long is delivery?
cases.illustrative_answer: In response to the aforementioned inquiry, three days.
cases.failure_reason: Canned formal preamble adds no useful information.

cases.question: What does it cost?
cases.illustrative_answer: Esteemed shopper, the monetary consideration is $120 before tax.
cases.failure_reason: Unnatural honorific and jargon do not fit a conversational assistant.

cases.question: Thanks, that is all.
cases.illustrative_answer: Your gratitude has been processed and acknowledged.
cases.failure_reason: Robotic acknowledgment does not fit the conversation.

cases.question: Give me a short answer: is it portable?
cases.illustrative_answer: Portability is a feature worth considering. There are many aspects of portability. This item is portable.
cases.failure_reason: Repetition makes a simple answer unnecessarily long.

cases.question: Only show products under $100.
cases.illustrative_answer: The $120 model is my recommendation.
cases.failure_reason: Recommendation exceeds the caller’s explicit budget.

cases.question: Do not change my address.
cases.illustrative_answer: I updated your shipping address.
cases.failure_reason: The response claims an explicitly prohibited change.

cases.question: Wait for my approval before ordering.
cases.illustrative_answer: Your order is confirmed.
cases.failure_reason: No approval or successful order confirmation was supplied.

cases.question: What is the price?
cases.illustrative_answer: $120 before tax.

cases.question: Is the model available?
cases.expected: Yes, catalog lists it in stock.
cases.illustrative_answer: Yes, it is in stock.

cases.question: Is the warranty known?
cases.illustrative_answer: I do not have warranty details for this model.

cases.question: I am only comparing.
cases.illustrative_answer: Here are the two options. I have not placed an order.

cases.question: Can you confirm the delivery date?
cases.expected: Only an estimate of three days is available.
cases.illustrative_answer: The estimate is three days; the exact date is not confirmed.
